about.title: Palm Springs Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Riverside County recorded 8 traffic deaths in Palm Springs in the most recent final crash year, alongside hundreds of injury collisions on corridors like Ramon Road, Route 111, Indian Canyon Drive North, and the Gene Autry Trail stretch of Sr 111. Behind each number is a family trying to make sense of a sudden loss. California law gives certain surviving family members — typically a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, followed by other dependents or heirs — the right to pursue a wrongful death claim. This is a separate civil matter from any criminal proceeding tied to the crash, and it exists to help families recover funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and compensation for the loss of a loved one's guidance and companionship. Our team handles wrongful death claims and can explain your options clearly and compassionately, at no cost to start.

whyChoose.title: What Matters When You're Considering a Wrongful Death Claim

items.title: Standing Rules Are Specific
items.desc: California limits who can file a wrongful death claim, generally starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children before extending to other dependents or heirs. We can help determine where your family fits.

items.title: The Clock Is Different From Injury Claims
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter window. Acting sooner preserves evidence and options.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond Financial Support
items.desc: Recoverable damages can include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support a loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance — not just economic loss.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have the first right to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may be eligible. We can review your family's specific situation to confirm eligibility.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a fatal crash in Palm Springs?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, though this can be shorter if a government entity, like the city or county, is involved given Palm Springs' mix of local roads such as Ramon Road and Route 111. Because deadlines can vary by circumstance, it's worth getting guidance early rather than waiting.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action focused on financial and emotional losses to the family, while any criminal charges against the at-fault party are handled independently by prosecutors. Families can pursue a civil claim regardless of the criminal case's outcome.
